notes: Checkout API is mostly POST; only GET /paymentLinks/{linkId} is allowlisted (GET /storedPaymentMethods returns stored card tokens and GET /sessions needs a sessionResult, so neither is used). No list endpoint exists, so the connect check reads a non-existent link: 404 means the key was accepted. Live host https://{prefix}-checkout-live.adyenpayments.com/checkout/v71 is from Adyen live-endpoint docs; the spec declares only the test server.
